name: Wood Nettle Gall Midge
desc: Wood Nettle Gall Midge (Dasineura investita): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Dasineura investita, the wood nettle gall midge, forms a gall that grows on the wood nettle plant Laportea canadensis. It was described in 2016 and is caused by a midge in the family Cecidomyiidae.
